high_level_description: The image depicts a large, outdoor sculpture titled "Triumph of Labour," located on a circular stone pedestal. The sculpture is made of metal and portrays a group of workers engaged in laborious tasks. There are five figures in total, each in dynamic poses that suggest physical effort and teamwork. One figure appears to be lifting or carrying a heavy load, while others assist or support the effort. The figures are depicted with a sense of realism, capturing the intensity and determination of manual labor.
